Energy Shield & Chaos Inoculation

The Bread and Butter Defense Layer of Caster Builds. Energy Shield acts as a Secondary Life Pool that Damage is taken from till it depletes. Normally, Chaos Damage is doubled against Energy Shield, but we can fully mitigate with
While the Tooltip for Energy Shield states that Poison and Bleed bypass Energy Shield, using
will also completely remove all Poison and Bleed Damage. Bleed doing no Damage is a known Bug, but a welcome one.

The better Solution is reducing the Recharge Delay.
also offers a solution here:
takes Base Duration away from the Recharge Delay (from 3 down to 2 Seconds) and with Faster Start of Recharge you can get it down to almost 1 Second, making the Build feel incredibly tanky.
Undead Archon
Archon of Undeath is a Powerful Temporary Buff. By default, it has a Duration of 10 Seconds and is followed by the Archon Recovery Period Buff, which lasts 20 Seconds.
The only way of gaining Undead Archon is with the
Notable and spamming Command Skills.
With the Archon Recovery Period being a Buff, returning to Character Select and logging back in will remove it, like all other Buffs. This is likely an unintended interaction and is considered a Bug.
Archon of Undeath Buff grants:
25% more Minion Damage
200% more Cooldown Recovery Rate of Command Skills
Temporary Minion Skills have 100% more Limit of Minions summoned
When gaining Archon of Undeath all Persistent Undead Minions are revived
Puppet Master

Puppet Master is a stacking Buff that grants various buffs to Command Skills and Minions. It is intended to reward a more active Minion playstyle. By default, the Buff can stack up to 5 times, with each Buff having an individual Duration of 8 Seconds. With further investment, the Maximum Stack Count can be increased to 11 and the Duration to 10 Seconds.
Puppet Master Buff grants:
10% increased Skill Speed with Command Skills
10% reduced Movement Speed Penalty with Command Skills
Minions deal 10% increased Damage with Command Skills
Minions have 2% increased Movement Speed
Minions have 3% increased Skill Speed.
It is recommended to aim for between 60 and 100% chance to gain a Stack on the Passive Tree.
Puppet Master cannot increase your Movement Speed with more than 100% reduced Penalty. It can only keep it the same as your Movement Speed.
Djinns
Djinns are persistent Minions that are always in your presence. Any Allies in Presence Modifiers on your Sceptre will affect them.
Each Djinn comes with a build-in Command Skill and up to 3 additional Skills can be unlocked with Ascendancy Points.
Unlike other Ascendancies, the
has very few small Ascendancy Nodes. The 2 Points into a Djinn will always grant the Base Djinn and one Specialized Skill.
Player Cooldown Recovery Rate does not affect Command Cooldowns, only Minion Cooldown Recovery Rate. Same for any Spell Damage Modifiers. Only Minion specific Modifiers affect the Djinns.
